nodes.label: InputBindings.ahk
nodes.rationale: The hotkey block: every global hotkey is Shift+Alt+<key> and delegates to a named function the tray also binds, so behaviour never drifts. Opens/closes with bare #HotIf because #HotIf bleeds across #Include.

nodes.label: Shift+Alt+Numpad7
nodes.rationale: Keypad tiles are bound only under digit names; with NumLock off the gesture is dead (Shift+Alt+Up/Down are the NumLock-independent aliases).

nodes.label: IsDoublePress()
nodes.rationale: A repeated modifier release is not enough: Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V looked like a double-tap and opened Spotlight. Rejects if a non-modifier key was pressed in between; blocks triple-press double firing.

nodes.label: UpdateKeyboardHook()
nodes.rationale: Calls KeyOpt('{All}','N') because InputHook.OnKeyDown fires only for keys with the Notify option; without it keystroke sounds only fired on a handful of keys.
